result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred transition-assistance position by providing up to six months of support at then-current rates. However, it does not itself require return of Customer Data within 30 days, specify a standard machine-readable format, or require certification of deletion thereafter. Merely referring to Sections 11.2 and 11.3 cannot establish compliance because their operative language is not supplied. The changes are otherwise targeted and professionally drafted, although the treatment and pricing of the required data export remain unclear.
